enunciado: Which of the following define generative AI?
alternativas: A type of artificial intelligence that can create new content including images, text, and music.
A specific application like a chatbot that utilizes AI technology.
A type of artificial intelligence that analyzes existing data to identify patterns and make predictions.
A type of artificial intelligence that focuses on automating repetitive tasks and improving efficiency.
explicacao: The term "generative" is directly associated with creating new content ("create new content"), which can span multiple modalities (text, image, music). Option B is too restrictive, as Generative AI is not limited to chatbots. Options C and D refer to traditional AI and conventional machine learning (focused on analyzing existing data to identify patterns, predictions, and automating repetitive tasks).
tema: Section 1.5: Generative AI Business Use Cases

referencia.titulo: AI and ML on Google Cloud

enunciado: A CEO is hesitant to invest in generative AI because they believe it's just a technology for building chatbots. Which of the following examples demonstrate that generative AI can offer their business much more?
alternativas: Scheduling meetings and managing calendars to help employees improve their time management.
Providing generic responses to all customer inquiries regardless of the specific issue.
Counting the number of website visitors and their locations.
Creating a photo realistic images of new product prototypes based on text description.
explicacao: Creating photorealistic images of new product prototypes based on text descriptions demonstrates the true power of Generative AI (multimodality and creating brand new/novel content), proving that it goes far beyond simple conversational assistants or traditional office tasks (like scheduling or traffic counting).
tema: Section 1.7: Core Layers of Gen AI Landscape

referencia.titulo: AI and ML on Google Cloud

enunciado: Which of the following describes multimodal Gen AI applications?
alternativas: Using Imagen to create an image for the website.
Using a NotebookLM business to summarize a financial report.
Using a Gen AI to analyze customer sentiments in video testimonials and survey data.
Using Gemini in Gmail to write.
explicacao: Multimodality refers to the capability of handling different types or formats of data simultaneously (such as text, images, code, audio, and video). Option C involves analyzing customer sentiments in video testimonials (audiovisual content) combined with survey data (text), which characterizes a multimodal application. The other options focus on only a single modality (only images in Imagen or only text in Gmail/NotebookLM).
tema: Section 1.7: Core Layers of Gen AI Landscape

referencia.titulo: AI and ML on Google Cloud

enunciado: Which of the following statements accurately describe Gemini? (Select Two)
alternativas: Gemini is a chatbot that can answer questions and generate creative content.
Gemini is a type of artificial intelligence that can create new content including text, images, music.
Gemini is a type of generative AI specifically designed for generating images.
Gemini is an AI assistant that can help you to be more creative and productive.
Gemini is a generative AI model or family of models developed by Google.
explicacao: Gemini is a family of models developed by Google and functions as an AI assistant focused on productivity and creativity. It is not a mere chatbot and is not designed exclusively for images (for that, Google has the Imagen model, and Lyra for music), invalidating the premise that it natively or exclusively generates all types of music/images in its base definition.
tema: Section 1.7: Core Layers of Gen AI Landscape

referencia.titulo: AI and ML on Google Cloud

enunciado: Which of the following statements accurately describe the relationship between foundation models and the Large Language Models (LLMs)? (Select Two)
alternativas: All Large Language Models are foundation models.
All foundation models are LLMs.
Foundation models are only used for research purpose while LLMs are used for practical application.
LLMs are specialized type of foundation models.
Foundation models and LLMs are unrelated concepts.
explicacao: Foundation models (FM) represent a broader category of massive models. LLMs (focused on language and text) are a specialization or a subset within foundation models. Therefore, all LLMs are foundation models and represent a specialized type of FM. Foundation models can also work with images, videos, and other media, and are not restricted to text or purely academic research.
tema: Section 1.7: Core Layers of Gen AI Landscape

referencia.titulo: AI and ML on Google Cloud

enunciado: For each of the following items describe if it is a foundation model or not. (Select Three)
alternativas: A deep learning model that can generate realistic images from text descriptions.
A decision tree model used to predict customer churn.
A linear regression model.
A model trained on a vast dataset of images and videos capable of understanding and generating visual content as well as answering questions about it.
A model trained on a massive dataset capable of translating languages and writing different kinds of creative content.
explicacao: Foundation models are trained on massive volumes of data and have adaptive capabilities to create or interpret complex content (such as photorealistic images from text descriptions, or translating languages and writing creative content). Statistical and traditional ML models, like Decision Trees or Linear Regression, are highly specialized and do not fall under the category of Foundation Models.
tema: Section 1.7: Core Layers of Gen AI Landscape

referencia.titulo: AI and ML on Google Cloud

enunciado: Which of the following define a foundation model?
alternativas: Small, very specialized AI.
Traditional machine learning algorithm that rely on explicitly defined rules.
Hardware infrastructure used to train and deploy AI model.
Large AI models trained on a vast quantity of data, capable of adapting to a variety of task.
explicacao: A foundation model is a large-scale AI model trained on a vast quantity of data, designed to be capable of adapting to a variety of downstream tasks (usually through fine-tuning by companies). It is not a hardware infrastructure nor does it refer to traditional algorithms.
tema: Section 1.7: Core Layers of Gen AI Landscape

referencia.titulo: AI and ML on Google Cloud

enunciado: What is the purpose of a prompt in a context of foundational models?
alternativas: To provide input to the model and trigger an output.
To fine-tune the model to a specific task.
To train the model on a new data.
To evaluate the model's performance.
explicacao: In the context of pre-trained foundation models, a prompt is simply the input (whether text, image, or other modality) provided by the user to trigger and generate a response/output from the model. It should not be confused with training, fine-tuning, or performance evaluation steps.
tema: Section 1.7: Core Layers of Gen AI Landscape

referencia.titulo: AI and ML on Google Cloud

enunciado: Which of the following is a primary feature of a foundation model?
alternativas: Adaptability across a wide range of tasks.
Limited to their initial pre-trained functions.
Specialization for a single task.
Training on small datasets.
explicacao: Adaptability across a wide range of different tasks is the primary characteristic that defines and differentiates foundation models. Unlike traditional ML models, they are not limited to a single specific task nor are they trained on small datasets.
tema: Section 1.7: Core Layers of Gen AI Landscape

referencia.titulo: AI and ML on Google Cloud

enunciado: What is the primary difference between foundation model and the traditional AI models?
alternativas: Foundation models are trained on specific data for a single task, while traditional models...
Foundation models are trained on a massive amount of diverse data for various tasks, while traditional models are trained on specific data for a single task.
Foundation models cannot be adapted to new tasks, while traditional models can.
Foundation models are only trained on text data.
explicacao: Foundation models are trained on a massive amount of diverse data for various tasks, while traditional AI models are highly specialized, trained on specific data to execute a single task (such as classification or prediction).
tema: Section 1.7: Core Layers of Gen AI Landscape

referencia.titulo: AI and ML on Google Cloud

enunciado: How do foundation models and prompt engineering work together to create value in a generative AI?
alternativas: Foundation models provide the computing power for generative AI, when prompt engineering directs that power to complete specific tasks.
Foundation models offer a vast knowledge base, and prompt engineering guides the model to use this knowledge in responses.
Foundation models ensure the ethical use of generative AI, while prompt engineering focuses on improving the quality and the creativity of the outputs.
Prompt engineering trains the foundation models.
explicacao: Foundation models act as a vast knowledge base due to their massive pre-training, while prompt engineering serves as the guide directing the model on how to utilize that knowledge to generate specific outputs. Option A is incorrect because hardware infrastructure provides computing power, not the foundation model. Option C is incorrect because ethical use is the responsibility of the users/developers, not the model itself. Option D is incorrect because prompt engineering does not train the model; it only provides inputs for inference.

enunciado: Why is it important for mid-level managers and individual contributors to be involved in a Gen AI adoption?
alternativas: They have limited understanding of daily operations and users.
Their proximity to workflows allows them to identify the most impactful Gen AI solutions.
They should avoid any involvement in Gen AI experimentation.
Their focus should be solely on technical implementation details.
explicacao: In the context of AI adoption strategies (Top-Down and Bottom-Up), mid-level managers and individual contributors represent the Bottom-Up approach. Because they work closely with daily workflows (front lines), they have real insights into operational pain points and can identify where Gen AI solutions will have the most significant practical impact.
tema: Section 1.1: Fundamentals of Gen AI Concepts

referencia.titulo: AI and ML on Google Cloud

enunciado: What is a key advantage of using Google Cloud's Gen AI ecosystem for businesses?
alternativas: It ensures businesses that they will achieve immediate and widespread success in all of their generative AI endeavors.
It forces each and every business to become an AI-first company.
It eliminates the need for companies to cultivate internal Gen AI knowledge and experimentation.
It allows businesses to leverage Google AI advancements without starting from scratch.
explicacao: The main advantage of the Google Cloud ecosystem is allowing businesses to leverage advanced Google AI innovations and advancements without having to start from scratch or rebuild complex models. The other options contain overly optimistic or mandatory statements (such as guaranteeing immediate success in everything or forcing all companies to be AI-first).

enunciado: What is the recommended approach for businesses to effectively implement Gen AI?
alternativas: Focus on a top-down strategy driven by executives.
Focus on a bottom-up approach with no overarching plan.
Adopt the latest Gen AI trends.
Combine a top-down strategic vision with bottom-up input from teams.
explicacao: The ideal Google-recommended approach combines a top-down strategic vision from executive leadership with bottom-up input and practical feedback from operational teams. Isolated strategies (only executives driving it or only teams experimenting with no central plan) do not work effectively.
tema: Section 1.1: Fundamentals of Gen AI Concepts

referencia.titulo: AI and ML on Google Cloud

enunciado: Which of the following is a benefit of using Google Cloud for Gen AI developments?
alternativas: It offers a limited set of pre-trained AI models for specific industry use cases.
It focuses primarily on individual developer tools without robust governance or scalability features.
It requires extensive upfront hardware investment for running complex AI workloads.
It provides a comprehensive service including scalable infrastructure, enterprise grade governance and security.
explicacao: Google Cloud provides a comprehensive set of services ranging from scalable infrastructure to enterprise-grade governance and security, unlike partial solutions that lack corporate robustness or require massive on-premise hardware investments.

enunciado: A developer is adding an AI component to a complex video game. The AI interacts with the game environment, taking actions and receiving rewards based on the outcomes of those actions through trial and error. What type of machine learning is this?
alternativas: Reinforcement Learning
Supervised Learning
Unsupervised Learning
explicacao: In Reinforcement Learning, the agent learns by interacting with the environment, taking actions and receiving feedback in the form of rewards or penalties through trial and error. The main key terms identified are: interaction with the environment, rewards, and trial and error.

enunciado: An email provider develops a spam filter to classify incoming emails as either spam or not spam. The model is trained on a dataset of emails that have been manually labeled. What type of machine learning is this?
alternativas: Supervised Learning
Unsupervised Learning
Reinforcement Learning
explicacao: In Supervised Learning, the model is trained using a labeled dataset where the correct answers (spam or not spam) are provided to guide the learning process.

referencia.titulo: AI and ML on Google Cloud

enunciado: Discovering underlying topics in a collection of documents, such as analyzing a set of news articles to identify the main topics being discussed, is an example of which type of machine learning?
alternativas: Unsupervised Learning
Supervised Learning
Reinforcement Learning
explicacao: In Unsupervised Learning, the model analyzes unlabeled data to identify hidden patterns, clusters, or internal structures (such as common topics) without external guidance. The key term is discovering underlying topics.

referencia.titulo: AI and ML on Google Cloud

enunciado: How does consistency impact AI model training?
alternativas: It increases the speed of data retrieval.
It reduces the need for data storage.
Inconsistent formats and labeling can confuse the model and hinder learning.
It ensures data is relevant to the task.
explicacao: Consistency in data formats and labeling is crucial. Inconsistent or incorrectly labeled data confuses the machine learning algorithm, impairing training quality and the final model's accuracy.

enunciado: Which of the following represents the correct order of steps in the Machine Learning (ML) lifecycle?
alternativas: Model Training -> Model Deployment -> Data Ingestion and Preparation -> Model Management
Data Ingestion and Preparation -> Model Deployment -> Model Training -> Model Management
Data Ingestion and Preparation -> Model Training -> Model Deployment -> Model Management
Model Deployment -> Model Training -> Model Management -> Data Ingestion and Preparation
explicacao: The machine learning lifecycle begins with data ingestion and preparation. Subsequently, the model is trained, then deployed into production, and finally monitored and managed through model management.

enunciado: What is the primary purpose of the data ingestion and preparation stage in the ML workflow?
alternativas: Deploying the trained models.
Collecting, cleaning, and transforming the raw data.
Training machine learning models.
Monitoring model performance.
explicacao: This stage aims to collect raw data from various sources, and then clean and transform them (ETL process) to ensure they are ready and usable for the training algorithm.

enunciado: What is a model in the context of machine learning?
alternativas: A set of predefined rules for decision making.
A type of computer hardware.
A visual representation of data.
A complex mathematical structure that processes inputs to generate outputs.
explicacao: A machine learning model is a complex mathematical structure that has learned patterns from training data, allowing it to process inputs to generate new predictions or outputs. It is not a mere set of predefined rigid rules.
tema: Section 1.1: Fundamentals of Gen AI Concepts

referencia.titulo: AI and ML on Google Cloud

enunciado: Which of the following is an example of unstructured data?
alternativas: A spreadsheet with customer names, addresses, and purchase history.
A database storing customer records.
A table with predefined schema.
A collection of customer reviews in the form of free text paragraphs.
explicacao: Customer reviews in free-text format do not follow a predefined structure of rows and columns (unlike relational databases and spreadsheets), representing the perfect example of unstructured data.

enunciado: What is the primary way that agents learn in reinforcement learning?
alternativas: By being explicitly programmed with the correct actions.
By observing and imitating expert demonstrations.
By interacting with their environment and receiving feedback in the form of rewards or penalties.
By analyzing large datasets of labeled data.
explicacao: The reinforcement learning agent learns by making autonomous decisions and receiving feedback signals (rewards for correct actions and penalties for mistakes), optimizing its action policy over time. The key terms are interacting with their environment and receiving feedback.\n---

enunciado: Which of the following statements accurately describe the difference between Gemini and Gemma?
alternativas: Gemini is a model capable of generating video content from text or images, while Gemma is a model that specializes in code generation.
Gemini is a family of lightweight open models, while Gemma is Google's flagship closed model.
Gemini is a multimodal model that can process and generate various data types including text, images, and audio, while Gemma is a family of lightweight open models suitable for local deployment.
Both Gemini and Gemma are text-to-image diffusion models that excel at high-quality image generation.
explicacao: Gemini is Google's flagship commercial and multimodal model, capable of processing text, images, audio, and code. Gemma is the family of open, lightweight models optimized for efficient, local deployments.
tema: Section 1.5: Generative AI Business Use Cases

referencia.titulo: AI and ML on Google Cloud

enunciado: Which of the following statements explains the key difference between Imagen and Veo?
alternativas: Both Imagen and Veo are multimodal models that can process various types of data.
Imagen is a text-to-video model, while Veo is an image-to-text model.
Imagen is a family of lightweight open models, while Veo is a large language model.
Imagen is a text-to-image diffusion model that generates images from text, while Veo is a model capable of generating video content from text or images.
explicacao: Imagen is Google's specialized model focused on high-quality text-to-image generation and editing. Veo is Google's advanced video model, capable of creating high-definition photorealistic videos from text prompts or images.

referencia.titulo: AI and ML on Google Cloud

enunciado: Which of the following best describes the purpose of grounding in generative AI?
alternativas: To improve the speed and efficiency of AI inference.
To encourage the AI to generate more creative and novel outputs.
To enhance the accuracy and reliability of the AI-generated content by connecting it to verifiable resources.
To reduce the complexity of AI model architectures.
explicacao: Grounding anchors the model's responses in real, verifiable information sources, which drastically reduces the chance of "hallucinations" and improves the reliability of the generated data.

enunciado: What is the primary purpose of grounding in Generative AI?
alternativas: To reduce the cost of model deployment.
To connect the AI model's outputs to verifiable resources to ensure accuracy and reduce hallucinations.
To increase the speed and efficiency of AI models.
To improve the AI's ability to generate purely creative content.
explicacao: The role of grounding is to link generated outputs with reliable sources and facts, ensuring the model does not confidently invent false information.

enunciado: Which type of foundation model would be the most suitable for generating photorealistic images from textual descriptions?
alternativas: Large Language Model
Classification Model
Diffusion Model
Multimodal Model
explicacao: Diffusion Models, such as Imagen, are the gold standard architectures and most suitable for generating photorealistic images from text descriptions.

enunciado: Which techniques can be used to overcome the limitations of foundation models' performance?
alternativas: Data collection and hardware upgrades only.
Increasing processing power and memory.
Preventing hallucinations by restricting external access.
Grounding, prompting, fine-tuning, and Human-in-the-Loop (HITL).
explicacao: Overcoming the limitations of a foundation model (such as knowledge cutoff or hallucinations) requires a combination of techniques like prompt engineering, grounding to external sources, fine-tuning, and human review (HITL).

enunciado: Which type of foundation model is specifically designed to understand and generate human language?
alternativas: Large Language Model (LLM)
Diffusion Model
Image Generation Model
Predictive Model
explicacao: Large Language Models (LLMs) are foundation models trained specifically on large volumes of textual data to comprehend (understand) and generate human natural language coherently and fluidly.

referencia.titulo: AI and ML on Google Cloud

enunciado: Why are fine-tuning and customization important factors when choosing a foundation model?
alternativas: They ensure that the model is always available.
They increase the model's context window.
They allow the model to be adapted to specific tasks or domains.
They reduce the cost of using the model.
explicacao: While foundation models are excellent generalists, fine-tuning allows them to adapt their general skills to solve highly specific and focused tasks or business rules of a company.
tema: Section 1.7: Core Layers of Gen AI Landscape

referencia.titulo: AI and ML on Google Cloud

enunciado: What is the primary role of Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) in the machine learning lifecycle?
alternativas: To automate all decision-making processes.
To integrate human expertise into the ML process, especially for tasks requiring judgment or context.
To replace AI algorithms entirely in the production phase.
To eliminate the need for data collection.
explicacao: HITL (Human-in-the-Loop) ensures the integration of human intelligence and judgment into the AI lifecycle, which is indispensable for auditing outputs, adjusting contextual nuances, and making critical governance decisions that AI alone cannot handle.\n---

enunciado:
In the AI landscape, match the function with the correct layer of the AI landscape (Model or Agent):
1. Generating programmatically correct and stylistically appropriate text.
2. Organizing and formatting the content according to specific guidelines.
alternativas: Function 1 belongs to the Model layer; Function 2 belongs to the Agent layer.
Both functions belong to the Model layer.
Both functions belong to the Agent layer.
Function 1 belongs to the Agent layer; Function 2 belongs to the Model layer.
explicacao: Generating grammatically and stylistically correct text is a baseline task performed by the **Model** layer. Dynamically organizing and formatting this content according to specific user workflows or rules involves the dynamic control of the **Agent** layer.

enunciado:
Consider an AI-powered educational platform that provides personalized learning experiences to students. Match the following functions to either the Model or Agent layer:
1. Evaluating a student's short answer response to an open-ended question considering factors like factual accuracy, completeness, and clarity of expressions.
2. Customizing learning materials and exercises for each student.
3. Tracking student progress and adapting the learning experience.
alternativas: All functions belong to the Agent layer.
Function 1 belongs to the Model layer; Functions 2 and 3 belong to the Agent layer.
Functions 1 and 2 belong to the Model layer; Function 3 belongs to the Agent layer.
All functions belong to the Model layer.
explicacao: Point-in-time evaluation of a response (text) is performed by the **Model** layer. Customizing study materials and dynamically adapting the learning experience based on the student's historical progress require the **Agent** layer (which interacts, reasons, and makes decisions in the workflow).

enunciado: A data science team is training a new generative AI model on a massive dataset of images. They need access to powerful hardware and software resources to handle the computationally intensive training process. Which layer of the Gen AI landscape would provide the necessary computational power and storage?
alternativas: Model layer
Platform layer
Agent layer
Infrastructure layer
explicacao: Raw hardware resources, such as processing power (GPUs, TPUs, CPUs) and large-scale data storage, are the sole responsibility of the **Infrastructure** layer.

enunciado: What are the two key elements that distinguish AI agents from standalone AI models?
alternativas: Reasoning loop and tools.
Pre-trained weights and fine-tuning.
Large context windows and vector databases.
Hardware acceleration and cloud APIs.
explicacao: AI agents differ from standalone AI models by having two key elements: a **reasoning loop**, which allows them to plan and evaluate steps iteratively, and access to **tools**, such as external APIs and databases.
tema: Section 1.7: Core Layers of Gen AI Landscape

referencia.titulo: AI and ML on Google Cloud

enunciado: A travel agency wants to use an AI agent to help customers plan their vacations, book flights, and provide ongoing support. How would the Agent layer and the Application layer work together to create this AI-powered travel planning experience?
alternativas: The Agent layer would provide the user interface, while the Application layer...

enunciado: What is the purpose of Auto ML in Vertex AI?
alternativas: To allow users to build and train AI models with minimal technical expertise.
To manage and monitor the performance of deployed AI models.
To provide pre-trained models for various use cases.
To automate the entire ML workflow from data preparation to deployment.
explicacao: Auto ML in Vertex AI is designed to enable users to build and train high-quality models with minimal technical expertise and effort, removing the need to write complex training code or manually tune network hyperparameters.

enunciado: What are GPUs and TPUs in the context of AI infrastructure?
alternativas: Software applications for managing AI models.
Networking protocols.
Specialized processors designed for parallel processing in AI tasks.
Storage devices.
explicacao: Graphical Processing Units (GPUs) and Tensor Processing Units (TPUs, developed by Google) are specialized hardware processors designed specifically for massive parallel processing, dramatically accelerating AI model training and inference.

enunciado: Why is high-performance storage important for generative AI?
alternativas: To automate the deployment and management of AI models.
To store and efficiently access the massive datasets used in AI training.
To ensure the responsible use of AI systems.
To provide a user-friendly interface.
explicacao: Training generative AI models involves gigantic datasets (peta-scale). High-performance storage ensures extremely fast read/write (I/O) rates, preventing compute bottlenecks that would keep expensive processors (like GPUs/TPUs) idle.

enunciado: Which of the following statements best describes Model Garden on Vertex AI?
alternativas: A platform for managing and monitoring AI infrastructure.
A service designed for finding and deploying pre-trained AI models.
A service for discovering, customizing, and deploying pre-trained Google and third-party AI models.
A platform for developing AI models from scratch.
explicacao: Model Garden on Vertex AI acts as a centralized catalog ("one-stop shop") where businesses can discover, customize (tune parameters and perform fine-tuning), and deploy both native Google models (such as the Gemini family) as well as open-source and third-party models (such as LLaMA and Claude).
tema: Section 1.7: Core Layers of Gen AI Landscape

referencia.titulo: AI and ML on Google Cloud

enunciado: What is the role of MLOps in Vertex AI?
alternativas: To learn how best to achieve a goal based on inputs and tools.
To provide physical hardware for the AI systems.
To automate, standardize, and manage the ML project lifecycle.
To allow users to interact with AI capabilities.
explicacao: MLOps (Machine Learning Operations) focuses on automating, standardizing, and managing the entire ML project lifecycle. It builds repeatable pipelines connecting model development to deployment, monitoring, and continuous updating, treating AI as a journey of continuous improvement rather than a single destination.

enunciado: You need a model that can generate realistic images from text descriptions for your new marketing campaign. You have some coding skills but you are running short on time. Which path would you choose?
alternativas: Use a pre-trained API to generate images quickly.
Build a custom image generation model from scratch.
Fine-tune a pre-trained text-to-image model from Model Garden.
explicacao: When facing severe time constraints, the recommended strategy is to leverage existing AI advancements without reinventing the wheel. Calling a ready-to-use pre-trained API (like Imagen) delivers professional results instantly.

enunciado: What is Gemini Nano designed for?
alternativas: Running complex AI models on high-performance cloud servers.
Deploying on edge devices like smartphones for on-device AI tasks.
Creating music and audio generation.
Processing massive databases in data centers.
explicacao: Gemini Nano is the most efficient and lightweight model of the Gemini family, developed specifically by Google to execute locally (on-device) on smartphones and other low-power edge hardware, enabling ultra-fast offline processing.
tema: Section 1.7: Core Layers of Gen AI Landscape

referencia.titulo: AI and ML on Google Cloud

enunciado: Who is responsible for building and deploying custom AI agents and integrating AI capabilities into applications?
alternativas: Developers
AI Practitioners
Business Leaders
Network Engineers
explicacao: Developers are primarily responsible for the technical coding of the end-user application layer, consuming AI APIs to integrate new computational features, build customized agents, and implement user interfaces.
tema: Section 1.7: Core Layers of Gen AI Landscape

enunciado: What is the primary advantage of edge computing for AI applications?
alternativas: Increased data storage capability.
Lower overall development cost.
Real-time responsiveness and reduced latency.
Reduced need for data pre-processing.
explicacao: The fundamental advantage of edge computing is bringing processing closer to where data is generated (such as a smartphone or sensor). This drastically reduces latency and enables ultra-high-speed real-time interactive responsiveness.

One-shot prompting
Few-shot prompting

enunciado: How does grounding improve the reliability of Gemini or Custom Gems?
alternativas: It completely prevents Gemini from generating any inaccurate responses in all scenarios.
It connects the Gemini's output to specific, verifiable sources of information.
It enables Gemini to learn from user interactions over time and self-train.

To restrict the AI output to a predefined static set of hardcoded responses.
explicacao: RAG is the technical architecture that retrieves information from an external database or documents, injects this data as dynamic context into the user prompt, and utilizes the model's linguistic intelligence to generate extremely precise and updated responses.

enunciado: For the following scenario, determine which would be a better primary prompt technology, ReAct (Reasoning and Action) or CoT (Chain of Thought): "Find a highly rated Italian restaurant nearby."
alternativas: ReAct (Reasoning and Action)
CoT (Chain of Thought)
Neither of them
Traditional Machine Learning
explicacao: Requesting to find a highly rated Italian restaurant nearby requires an external action in the physical world (searching the web or a maps API) combined with analytical reasoning to select the best result. Therefore, **ReAct (Reasoning and Action)** technology is ideal, as it engages the external search loop.

enunciado: For the following scenario, determine which would be a better primary prompt technology, ReAct or CoT (Chain of Thought): "Summarize a long article about history."
alternativas: ReAct (Reasoning and Action)
CoT (Chain of Thought)
Standard direct prompt without reasoning
Reinforcement Learning
explicacao: To summarize a long article provided directly to the model, there is no need for external interactions or web searches. The model needs to conduct internal structured analytical reasoning to distill the main points. Thus, **CoT (Chain of Thought)** is the best technical choice.

enunciado: For the following scenario, determine which would be a better primary prompt technology, ReAct or CoT (Chain of Thought): "Brainstorming creative marketing ideas for a new campaign."
alternativas: ReAct (Reasoning and Action)
CoT (Chain of Thought)
Deterministic template matching
Reinforcement Learning
explicacao: Brainstorming creative and innovative concepts is a purely idea-generating and internal logical chaining task. There is no need to fetch dynamic web data in real-time or call external APIs, justifying the use of **CoT (Chain of Thought)** to guide the model step-by-step in generating structured ideas.

enunciado: For the following scenario, determine which would be a better primary prompt technology, ReAct or CoT (Chain of Thought): "Searching for a specific research paper on a particular scientific topic."

CoT (Chain of Thought)
Standard Zero-shot prompting
Traditional Linear Regression

enunciado: Which of the following statements best describes the function of a reasoning loop within a generative AI agent?

explicacao: Unlike a traditional chatbot based on a static decision flow, an AI agent has a **Reasoning Loop** that evaluates inputs iteratively (observation, internal thought about what action to take, tool usage, and re-evaluation) until the final goal is reached autonomously.

Generation (Z):** The model processes this enriched prompt and generates the final response based exclusively on the provided facts.

enunciado: What is the defining characteristic of Reinforcement Learning (RL) in machine learning?

explicacao: In **Reinforcement Learning**, the model (called an agent) does not receive direct right answers initially, but learns to maximize its long-term performance by taking actions in a dynamic environment and receiving reward or penalty signals as feedback.
